scope: Four new current national records and one material same-event refresh, including two prior-window implementation/source-completion recoveries; no historical correction.

changes.summary: A preliminary injunction reinstated judicially appointed Seattle U.S. attorney Roger Rogoff while appeal and final merits remain unresolved.
changes.duplicate_review: Reviewed against normalized titles, dates, source URLs, current entries and recent merged maintenance releases; other appointment disputes involved different offices and rulings.

changes.summary: Treasury issued Iran rail and automotive sectoral determinations and designated industrial networks and foreign suppliers.
changes.duplicate_review: The new sectoral authority and target set were separated from earlier banking, aviation, proxy and digital-asset sanctions.

changes.summary: Treasury and IRS issued temporary and proposed rules for the 2027 federal scholarship tax credit.
changes.duplicate_review: No same-event tax or education record was found; statutory authorization, temporary rules and proposed provisions were kept in one regulatory-package record.

changes.summary: Military-wide hostile-fire and imminent-danger pay increases took effect October 1.
changes.duplicate_review: Compensation implementation was distinguished from personnel reductions, combat operations and prior Marine advance notice.

changes.summary: The Cox charge was dismissed after a district judge found the federal noncitizen-voting law unconstitutional in that case.
changes.duplicate_review: The ruling advances the constitutional challenges already covered by the stable enforcement record and was not counted as a parallel event.
